messages:
maria: Heads up — planning to start gradual rollout of the structured-output / fncall path tomorrow AM. I want to confirm the compat flag semantics and client SDK fallback behavior before we flip anything. TL;DR: need a short checklist and who will monitor the canary.
jamal: Thanks — quick bullets?
maria: - Flag names we discussed: `so_enabled` + `so_compat=v2|v1` (v2 = strict structured outputs, v1 = shim fallback). Is that what people expect?
kevin: yep that's the plan. one nuance: mobile SDKs will receive `so_compat=v1` by default until we ship the client shim update. So server -> client flag mapping is `so_enabled=true` + `so_compat`.
sarah: Clarify: if client gets `so_compat=v2` but doesn't implement strict parsing, it should still be safe, right? We agreed the runtime will insert a compatibility wrapper for older clients.
kevin: Correct — runtime does a soft-fallback. Flow:
```
if client_supports_strict():
  return structured_payload
else:
  return shimmed_text_output
```
We expose that through the SDKs as `responses.strictStructuredOutput` boolean.
maria: Perfect. For rollout strategy: start with internal + dev-team canary (5% traffic) -> infra + selected external partners (10%) -> broader gradual ramp (25, 50, 100). Any objections?
jamal: Add guardrails: 1) metrics alert for regression >= 3x error rate on parse failures 2) latency P95 delta > 50ms 3) token cost delta > 2x for top routes
sarah: Also add quality gate tied to eval set: if structured outputs fail more than 5% of eval prompts (function call mismatch / schema violations) -> auto-rollback.
kevin: Who runs the canary monitoring dashboard? I can own the initial dashboard and set alerts, but need someone to do triage during the window.
maria: Can you pair with jamal for alerts? Jamal will be primary on-call the rollout day 10:00-18:00 PT.
jamal: Ack. I'll create the dashboard (model/route breakdown, parse_failure_rate, p95_latency, token_cost_estimate) and wire alerts to #incidents + my mobile.
rollout-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-start at 2025-09-02T17:00Z; canary duration 2h; auto-rollup disabled. See <https://deploys.internal/release/so-rollout-195>
maria: Quick ask — SDK owners: do we need a feature flag change in SDKs before server-side flip? Kevin?
kevin: Mobile SDKs need a small patch to expose `strictStructuredOutput` toggle; web/sdk will be ready in staging by EOD. I'll open PR and ping owners.
maria: OK. Who will do canary QA? suggest: api-e2e + samples smoke tests + 10 curated user prompts run through eval harness.
sarah: I'll run the eval harness during canary and post results in this thread.
jamal: I'll prepare an emergency rollback playbook in ops-runbook with exact flag names and steps. quick checklist in ops-runbook:
- set `so_enabled=false` globally
- set `so_compat=v1` for all clients
- scale down canary routing
- notify customers & postmortem template
maria: Nice. Final ask: please ack in thread when your PRs/dashboards/runbook are up so I can flip the switch tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4021 — adds `strictStructuredOutput` and maps server flag.
jamal: Dashboard + alerts created, runbook updated. I'll DM the oncall rotation.
sarah: Eval harness run started — will post results within 45m.
maria: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 15m async check-in 30m into the canary window. If no major alerts, we proceed to partner phase. :rocket:
